stories.title: Proper Voltage, Unigrid unveil sodium-ion storage solution for data centers
stories.description: The Salt Vault High Power cabinet aims to deliver some of the benefits of sodium-ion chemistries including the concept that rapid and repeated power transients may not degrade sodium-ion batteries as fast as lithium and lead-acid.

stories.title: Mexico’s solar capacity could reach 43.8 GW by 2035
stories.description: GlobalData has raised its solar growth forecast for Mexico by 6 GW, citing a growing pipeline of renewable energy projects. However, grid congestion, transmission constraints and regulatory uncertainty could slow deployment.

stories.title: Traumatized teens sue school, cops after Doritos bag triggers AI gun alert
stories.description: Lawsuit: Over 99% of school system’s AI gun alerts were false positives.

stories.title: Google turns to Blue Origin for a rocket, but its long-term problem remains
California AG subpoenas Nvidia over worries about Huang’s ties with China
stories.description: "The conduct of Nvidia and its former CEO raises bright red flags, including about the ways in which the company may have misled investors," California AG Rob Bonta said.

stories.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
stories.description: Everful has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform, helping retailers source products from overseas manufacturers.

stories.title: Mouldy, infested housing for vulnerable people sold as ethical investments abroad
stories.description: The properties are marketed at premium prices with claims of “government-backed” returns, the BBC finds.

stories.title: How did Anthropic's stock market debut unfold?
stories.description: The BBC's Samira Hussain breaks down the AI company's first day as a publicly traded company, as shares closed up 17%.

stories.title: Prior Knowledge or Search? A Study of LLM Agents in Hardware-Aware Code Optimization
stories.description: arXiv:2605.19782v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM discovery and optimization systems are increasingly applied across domains, implementing a common propose-evaluate-revise loop. Such optimization or discovery progresses via context conditioning on received feedback from an environment.

stories.title: KnowMe Paper Radar: Lightweight Discovery of Promising Papers in the Age of Autoresearch
stories.description: arXiv:2611.23702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing volume of topically similar papers makes it difficult to identify new work that can offer useful research insights or methodological guidance. We present KnowMe Paper Radar, a lightweight discovery tool that combines multiple sources of evidence into personalized reading priorities.

stories.title: $64 solar-powered robot cleans PV modules without water
stories.description: Researchers in Pakistan and China have developed an autonomous PV cleaning system that uses voltage differences between reference panels to detect soiling. Three months of field testing showed an 86.7% increase in power output after cleaning, with cleaning intervals ranging from four to 14 days.

stories.title: Auditing Path-Specific Fairness Across Causal Discovery Algorithms: A Heart Failure Case Study
stories.description: arXiv:2603.15926v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Causal discovery is increasingly applied to healthcare data, where the recovered relationships can encode biased pathways that propagate to downstream prediction.
